brief.topic: Sealed technical evidence for AI-for-anyone/loop-now@v0.2.0 to fill the ZOnePersonNetwork cross-comparison: which of the 12 personal-collaboration-network modules are declared, and how. Commit-pinned to tag v0.2.0. No adoption ranking.

criteria.question: Which projects declare a task/work-item module, and what lifecycle or board semantics does it expose?
How are people, agents, rooms and scopes modeled as distinct identities?
What session lifecycle, restart safety and context handoff are declared?
keywords: reusing its task workspace and session

criteria.question: What execution isolation unit is used (worktree, sandbox, pane) and how is parallel work arranged?
keywords: agent keeps its own working directory

criteria.question: Which Human approval, security posture or intervention gates are declared?
keywords: Ask me through Inbox if a decision is needed

criteria.question: How are results, reviews, audit history and provenance recorded?
What shared memory or knowledge layer exists, and what is its source of truth?
How are progress, status, stalls and health made observable?
How are skills, configuration, policies and deployment directories owned?
What runtime and integration shape is declared (local-first, own cloud, interface abstraction)?
Is there an explicit agent-to-agent protocol, typed message format or agent discovery surface?
What technical design facts are declared: core loop, persistence substrate, tool surface, storage?
keywords: Go API, scheduling, storage, and local execution
